name: Database
description: SurrealDB access mediated by the kernel. Plugins never open a DB connection or supply free-form SurQL by default; the kernel scopes every call to the active org and the plugin's allowed models.

capabilities.name: Query
capabilities.description: Structured reads: get / find by model name. The kernel builds parameterized SurQL — plugins do not send raw queries.

capabilities.name: Mutate
capabilities.description: Structured writes: create / update / delete by model name and field map. Kernel builds parameterized SurQL.

capabilities.name: Transaction
capabilities.description: Run a batch of structured db::* ops inside a single transaction.

capabilities.name: Raw SurQL
capabilities.description: Execute custom SurQL supplied by the plugin. High privilege — requires explicit grant. Still scoped to the org DB and subject to keyword denylist + optional model table binding.
